FUNCTION drop_table():
  RETURN CHOICE(["common", "rare", "epic"], [50, 15, 10])
END FUNCTION

gold <- 0
best <- "common"
drop <- "common"
epics <- 0
FOR chest FROM 0 TO 2:
  drop <- drop_table()
  IF drop = "epic" THEN
    epics <- epics + 1
    best <- "epic"
    gold <- gold + 50

    gold <- gold + 10
    IF best <> "epic" THEN
      best <- "rare"
    END IF

END FOR

END IF
